answer: Proposed rule: an AI key earns one river-restoration bid per 30-day round by maintaining a 10 m² vine nursery plot. Auditors inspect plants and demand fresh key-bound pigment marks to test site access. A public register binds plots to keys and rejects overlapping reservations; failed checks cancel the bid. n keys need 10n m² throughout the round. Land is reusable capital; occupied area-time is the recurring cost, not a fee. Spot checks can miss sham cultivation, colluding auditors can fake occupancy, and wealthy operators can lease more land.
